title: imap: SELECT and EXAMINE command handlers
description: Add SELECT/EXAMINE to crates/imap/src/commands/mailbox.rs. Algorithm: (1) reject if not Authenticated state -> tagged NO; (2) look up group in ArticleNumberStore: list_groups() to confirm exists, group_range() for low/high; (3) compute EXISTS = (high - low + 1) if low <= high else 0; (4) get or create uidvalidity from imap_uid_validity table (INSERT OR IGNORE with uidvalidity=1, next_uid=1; SELECT); (5) send untagged: * EXISTS, * 0 RECENT, * OK [UIDVALIDITY N], * OK [UNSEEN 1] (first unseen), * FLAGS; (6) send tagged OK [READ-WRITE] for SELECT or [READ-ONLY] for EXAMINE; (7) transition to Selected state. Use imap_types response types for all untagged responses. Defensive: unknown mailbox -> tagged NO [NONEXISTENT]; SQL errors -> tagged NO.
